name: Running
overview: The Bible uses the imagery of running to describe both the believer's pursuit of God's commands and the dangers of fleeing from Him. Psalms 119:32 expresses a heart empowered to run the way of God's commandments, while Proverbs 1:16 warns of those whose feet run toward evil. Isaiah 40:31 encourages believers that those who wait on the Lord will run without weariness, symbolizing renewed strength in faithful endurance. This theme is further emphasized in Matthew 24:13, which assures salvation to those who endure to the end, highlighting running as a metaphor for persevering in faith rather than turning away.
